articles.summary: Associated Press Finance: KKR Real Estate: Q4 Earnings Snapshot. The New York-based company said it had a loss of 49 cents per share. Earnings, adjusted for non-recurring costs and stock option expense, were 22 cents per share. The real estate finance company posted revenue of $101.3 million in the period. Related tickers mentioned: KREF.
